title: Psalter Off. lect. hymn pairs: give option 1 its printed 'Quando officium dicitur …' rubric too?
prompt: In the psalter the book prints two Off. lect. hymns, each under its own rubric, e.g. p618 (Feria VI): 'Quando officium dicitur noctu vel summo mane: Galli cantu (LHym 234)' / 'Quando officium dicitur diurno tempore: Adesto rerum conditor (LHym 235)'; p624 (Sabbato): Lux æterna (LHym 237) / Deus de nullo veniens (LHym 238). The conflicts stage loads the second-loaded hymn as option 2 with its rubric (#20 Amoris sensus 'diurno tempore'; #131 Galli cantu and #184 Lux æterna 'noctu vel summo mane'), but the option-1 row (loaded earlier, e.g. Adesto gregobase:16749, Deus de nullo 16750) has option_txt NULL, so its printed rubric is not modeled. Fill option 1's option_txt from the page for every such pair?

options.label: Fill option 1's option_txt from the page
options.detail: override option_txt on the option-1 index rows of every psalter Off. lect. pair (the other rubric of the pair); a one-off sweep after the conflicts stage drains

options.label: Leave option 1 without text
options.detail: option 1 is understood as 'the other one'; only option 2 carries a rubric
